login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your coach.
login.tagline: Trainings, bookings and visits - all in one place.

account.mismatch: The new passwords do not match
account.first_login_text: Hi {name}! Please replace your temporary password to continue.
account.skip_holidays: Cancel sessions automatically on public holidays

credits.low_hint: You are running out of visits - talk to your coach.
credits.confirm_delete: Delete a card of {n} visits? Only for cards entered by mistake.
credits.no_templates: No card templates - add them under “Schedule”.

book.title: Sessions
book.cancel_closed_long: Cancelling is possible up to {h}h before the start - talk to your coach.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.confirm_cancel_session: {n} booked swimmers will see that the training is cancelled and get their visits back. Continue?
calendar.click_to_add: Click an empty spot to add a one-off session
calendar.force_hint: Books even when full or out of visits

swimmers.title: Swimmers ({n})
swimmers.confirm_reset: Generate a new password for {name}? The old one stops working.
swimmers.confirm_deactivate: Deactivate {name}? Upcoming bookings are cancelled and login is blocked.
swimmers.password_generated: The password is generated automatically and shown only once.
swimmers.credentials_hint: Send these to the swimmer. The password will not be shown again; it must be changed at first login.

schedule.templates_hint: E.g. “10 visits” - added with one click from the swimmers list.

reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: Every evening a report is written to disk (reports/ folder): who came when and how many visits are left. A backup in case the app stops working.
reports.auto_hint: The report is made every day at the chosen time and saved in the reports/ folder. Missed days are filled in automatically.
reports.mail_off: Sending e-mail is not set up on the server (mail_sender in config.json).
reports.no_address: Add an e-mail to your profile or below.
reports.zip_note: The files arrive in one ZIP archive (the CSVs open in Excel).

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.password_too_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must be different.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.too_far: Booking for this date is not open yet.
errors.no_credits: No visits left. Talk to your coach.
errors.cancel_too_late: Too late to cancel - talk to your coach.
errors.not_started: The session has not started yet.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own admin rights.
errors.session_has_visits: This session already has recorded visits.
errors.window_too_short: The time range must fit at least one slot.
errors.session_has_attendees: Swimmers are booked - remove them or cancel the training instead.
errors.too_many_members: Too many members on the account.
errors.self_booking_disabled: Your coach does the booking - please contact them.
errors.already_waiting: You are already on the waiting list.
errors.mail_not_configured: E-mail is not set up on the server.

availability.title: Availability
availability.hint: Set the days and hours you are available. The time is split automatically into slots ({len} min by default) with up to {cap} swimmers each. Swimmers pick a slot in the calendar.
availability.edit_note: Changing days or hours applies from today on - past sessions stay in the history. Bookings move along if their time still exists; otherwise they are cancelled and the visit returned.
availability.confirm_delete: Remove the {day} {time} availability? Future bookings will be cancelled.

extra.title: One-off session
extra.hint: A session on a single date (extra or replacement).

legend.hint: Tap a free time to book.

day.confirm_cancel_all: Cancel {n} upcoming sessions on this day? Booked swimmers get their visits back.

session.book_hint: Uses 1 visit ({left} left). You can cancel up to {h}h before the start.
session.mark_after_start: Attendance can be marked once the session starts.
session.confirm_remove: Remove {name} from this session? The visit is returned.
session.called_off_swimmer: Your coach cancelled this training. Your visit was returned.
session.called_off_coach: Cancelled. The booked swimmers see the cancellation: {names}. Restoring it books them back in.
session.confirm_delete: Delete the training on {when}? It disappears from the calendar.
session.confirm_no_show: Are you sure? {name} will be marked as a no-show - this uses up 1 visit from the card.
session.note_ph: e.g. “Today at the Spartak pool, lane 3”
session.book_hint_many: Uses {n} visits ({left} left). You can cancel up to {h}h before the start.

comments.placeholder: Write a note about the swimmer - technique, progress, health…
comments.private: Comments are visible to coaches only.

members.label: Kids / members on this account (optional)
members.placeholder: e.g. John Mary  /  John, Mary  /  John; Mary
members.hint: If the card is used by someone else (e.g. a parent's account for their kid) or shared by several people, list their first names separated by spaces, commas or semicolons - up to {n}. The account books each of them into a slot; every place uses 1 visit. With one name it is picked automatically.

rules.intro: These rules apply to you and your swimmers. Changes are saved immediately.
rules.swimmers_can_book_hint: Turn off if only you book your swimmers.
rules.cancel_cutoff_hours_hint: How many hours before the start a swimmer can cancel on their own.
rules.booking_horizon_days_hint: How many days ahead swimmers can book.
rules.low_credit_threshold_hint: Show a warning when this many visits or fewer are left.
rules.default_slot_minutes_hint: Default for new slots and availability.
rules.skip_holidays_hint: Repeating slots on a public holiday are cancelled automatically.

notes.coach_ph: 📝 Note on this visit (the swimmer sees it too)…
notes.swimmer_ph: ✉️ Note to the coach (e.g. “10 min late”)…

ack.changed_reconfirm: Your coach changed this visit - please confirm again
ack.dispute_q: What is wrong with this visit? Your coach will see your comment.
ack.disputed_sent: Visit disputed - your coach will see it
ack.final_hint: Final: changes that cost a visit need the swimmer's approval
ack.request_confirm: {name}'s visit is final. This change would cost them a visit, so they have to approve it. Send a request?
ack.withdraw: If everything is fine, confirm - this withdraws the dispute.

today.unmarked: {n} not marked - they count as attended.

wait.joined: You are on the waiting list
wait.hint: No places left. Join the waiting list - if a place frees up you are booked automatically.
wait.promoted: A place freed up - you are booked:

absence.title: Coach absence
absence.hint: All your trainings in the period are cancelled; booked swimmers get their visits back and see the reason.
absence.extend: Extend all active cards by the days of the absence
absence.undo_confirm: Put the trainings and card dates back as they were?

msg.title: Message to swimmers
msg.hint: Swimmers see it as a message in their calendar until they read it.

insights.title: Insights
insights.inactive_hint: No visit for 21 days and nothing booked ahead.
insights.low_hint: Below the threshold in your rules.
